description: Low-level debug output implementation for Zephyr OS, including printk functions, character output routines, and buffer management.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Default weak character output routine that does nothing, can be overridden by architecture-specific code.

methods.name: __printk_hook_install
methods.description: Installs a custom character output routine for printk.

methods.name: __printk_get_hook
methods.description: Retrieves the current character output routine for printk.

methods.name: buf_flush
methods.description: Flushes the buffer by outputting its contents via k_str_out.

methods.name: buf_char_out
methods.description: Adds a character to the buffer, flushing if full.

methods.name: char_out
methods.description: Wrapper around the installed character output routine.

methods.name: vprintk
methods.description: Core function for formatted debug output, handles logging and user context output.

methods.name: z_impl_k_str_out
methods.description: Outputs a string of characters via the character output routine, with optional locking.

methods.name: snprintk
methods.description: Formats a string into a buffer with size limit.

methods.name: vsnprintk
methods.description: Variadic version of snprintk, formats a string into a buffer with size limit.
